# FAQ-017 Engineering FAQ #17

Q: What is the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
A: Set the blast wheel liner bolt torque to 100 N·m for EQ-P3-L2-SB01. Verify torque after liner replacement and during the first production run post-maintenance. See SB-1002 and SOP-P2-L2-04 for fastener control and replacement procedures.

Q: What is the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A: Lubricate the main roll bearing at an interval of 185 hours for EQ-P2-L2-RR03. Record each lubrication action in the equipment log and follow lubricant type and delivery method in SOP-P2-L2-01.

Q: How often should shot media be topped up in Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
A: Perform shot media top-up at an interval of 40 hours for EQ-P3-L2-SB01. Top-up frequency must be adjusted only per wear observations documented in SB-1002 and recorded against the cabinet maintenance checklist in SOP-P2-L2-04.

Q: What is the dust collector pressure drop alarm threshold for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03)?
A: The dust collector pressure drop alarm is set to 1240 Pa for EQ-P2-L1-SB03. Upon alarm, follow the isolation and cleaning sequence in SB-1002 and SOP-P2-L2-04 before returning the unit to service.

Q: What is the required spindle warm-up time for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01)?
A: Allow a spindle warm-up time of 15 minutes for EQ-P1-L4-CN01 prior to starting precision operations. Record warm-up completion in the machine start log and reference SOP-P2-L2-01 for warm-up check steps.

Related documents: SB-1002, SOP-P2-L2-01, SOP-P2-L2-04
